body_md:
Seven Certified Roofing Contractors are listed for searchers comparing independently owned roofers with a Florida license checked. Three have a Fort Lauderdale board address; D'Agostino Roofing, Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc., Sovereign Roofing LLC, and DR Construction and Roofing Inc. list Pompano Beach, Oakland Park, Hollywood, and Tamarac. Stated service areas name Fort Lauderdale, Broward, or South Florida, and each DBPR record shows license rank Cert Roofing, status Current, Active or Current,Active, and expiration 08/31/2028.

## How we picked

Each listing needed a Florida DBPR license lookup showing a Certified Roofing Contractor license, license rank Cert Roofing, and a current, active status. License number, licensee, DBA, board address, expiration, and any licensure date come from that lookup and link to the DBPR source on the entry. Other facts are company-site statements. Independent ownership means the site calls the business family-owned, female-owned, woman-owned, minority-owned, or 2nd-generation family-owned, or says a named person founded or opened it, and the Florida filing or company site shows no parent company.

## At a glance

- All seven licenses expire on 08/31/2028 and show license rank Cert Roofing.
- Licensure dates on the DBPR record are 03/21/1990 for Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc., 05/31/1994 for Nast Roofing Co, 11/06/2008 for DR Construction and Roofing Inc., and 10/26/2009 for Planet Roofing Co.
- Nast Roofing Co, Planet Roofing Co, and Allied Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. have Fort Lauderdale board addresses. D'Agostino Roofing is in Pompano Beach, Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc. in Oakland Park, Sovereign Roofing LLC in Hollywood, and DR Construction and Roofing Inc. in Tamarac.
- Service areas name Fort Lauderdale for Nast Roofing Co, Planet Roofing Co, Allied Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc., and Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc. D'Agostino Roofing states Palm Beach, Broward, and Miami-Dade counties. DR Construction and Roofing Inc. states Broward, Palm Beach, and Miami-Dade. Sovereign Roofing LLC states South Florida.

## Things to know before you go

Read the stated service area against your city. Planet Roofing Co also names Oakland Park, Wilton Manors, Pompano Beach, Lauderdale Lakes, Sunrise, Broward County, Miami-Dade County, Palm Beach County, and South Florida. Nast Roofing Co names Fort Lauderdale, Broward County, Miami-Dade, and West Palm Beach. Nast lists site address 138 W. State Road 84, Fort Lauderdale, Florida 33315, and board address 138 SW 24 STREET, FORT LAUDERDALE Florida 33315.

Stated hours and phones: Planet Roofing Co, Monday-Sunday, 8:00 AM-8:00 PM, 954-600-1462, planetroofing@pcflc.com. Allied Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. states 24/7 live answering, 954-485-5922. DR Construction and Roofing Inc. lists 7AM-10PM, 7 days a week, calls answered 24/7, (754) 779-3650. Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc. lists Mon-Fri 8:00 am-5:00 pm, Sat-Sun closed, weekends by appointment, (954) 620-2911. No hours are in the facts for Nast Roofing Co, 954-475-0610; D'Agostino Roofing, 954-840-7000; or Sovereign Roofing LLC, +1 (754) 329-4412.

A few company-site statements are specific. Planet Roofing Co states financing for qualified homeowners and full liability and workers' compensation coverage. Allied Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. states a 10-year labor warranty on re-roofs and, on its site, general license CGC-1532879 and solar license CVC-57253. Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc. states that free estimates are available. DR Construction and Roofing Inc. states general contractor license CGC 1507284 on its site. D'Agostino Roofing lists full-service roofing and general contracting; the site legal name is D'Agostino & Sons Construction, Inc.

## FAQ

### Are these Florida roofing licenses current?

Yes. Each Florida DBPR lookup shows status Current, Active or Current,Active, license rank Cert Roofing, and expiration 08/31/2028. License facts link to the DBPR source on the entry.

### Who is named as owner, and is a parent company shown?

Named owners are Tim Nast (family-owned; he founded it), Gentian Kraja (family-owned), Anna Swierczynska (female-owned and family-owned; CEO and co-founder with her husband Kriss), Peter D'Agostino (family owned; opened it with his two sons), Richard Smith (2nd-generation family-owned), Sherleen Fernandez (minority-owned), and Leon Meir (family-owned and woman-owned). Ownership notes show no parent company.

### Which companies state weekend or after-hours contact?

Planet Roofing Co lists Monday-Sunday, 8:00 AM-8:00 PM. Allied Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. states 24/7 live answering. DR Construction and Roofing Inc. lists 7AM-10PM, 7 days a week, and calls answered 24/7. Reliant Roofing Systems, Inc. lists weekends by appointment. Hours are not in the facts for the other three.
